content.title: Hershey Entertainment & Resorts Celebrates Earth Day 2026
content.text: Recycling and Conservation in The Sweetest Place on Earth Written by: Emily Strange All year in Hershey, Pa., we celebrate what matters most: our planet Earth! Hershey Entertainment & Resorts (HE&R) is dedicated to reducing our environmental footprint with the support of our guests and team members. Thanks to HE&R's initiatives, the company successfully conserved the following resources in 2025: 2025 Recycling & Waste Summary CELEBRATE EARTH DAY WITH US IN HERSHEY, PAPARTY FOR THE PLANET AT ZOOAMERICAIn honor of Earth Day, ZooAmerica North American Wildlife Park will host a Party for the Planet on April 18, 2026!ZooAmerica will be open on April 18, from 10 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., with Party for the Planet activities running from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. This is a unique opportunity for guests of all ages to visit an AZA-accredited zoo, experience animal encounters, celebrate the Earth's biodiversity and learn how to help protect planet Earth! 23.ZooAmerica.Party for the Planet.Rock Painting Activitiy 23.ZooAmerica.Party for the Planet.Animal Encounter Milton Hershey School Earth Day CelebrationJoin us at the Milton Hershey School Earth Day Celebration! Located at the Horticultural Center (260 Ivanhoe Lane, Hershey Pa.) We will have various activities to celebrate our planet including: GamesCraftsShopping at Project MarketAnd More!
